name: Darien Sills-Evans
bio: Darien Sills-Evans is an actor and producer.

credits.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
credits.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

credits.title: So Fly Christmas
credits.overview: After being stood up at the altar on Christmas Eve, Wyvetta loses her love on her favorite holiday. To show solidarity, Wyvetta's best friend, Dione suggests that the two of them renounce love. Things become complicated when Dione falls for a mild-mannered record store owner and tries to keep it under wraps.

credits.title: D.A.D.
credits.overview: A workaholic father comes home to discover his twin daughters have built a digital android doppelgänger that they lovingly call D.A.D.

credits.title: Harana
credits.overview: In 1995 Las Vegas, a homesick cover band singer writes an original song to connect with her daughter who is growing up in the Philippines without her.

credits.title: Charlie Says
credits.overview: Three young women were sentenced to death in the infamous Manson murder case, but when the death penalty was lifted, their sentence became life imprisonment. One young graduate student was sent in to teach them – and through her we witness their transformations as they face the reality of their horrific crimes.

credits.title: One Bedroom
credits.overview: Breaking up is easy. Moving out is hard. Especially when there's a New York City apartment involved. credits.title: Big Words
credits.overview: Members of a once-promising hip-hop group, now in their late 30s, struggle with regret, disappointment, and change on Election Night 2008.

credits.overview: After his mother dies, Sequan, a sensitive teenager from Brooklyn, moves in with relatives living in a small town plagued with secrets hidden deep within its lush, rural Alabama terrain.
